summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stock Invoice Import via OCR (Gemini 2.5 Pro) feature. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Import Invoice button and dialog working correctly with all expected UI elements. Regression: All main pages (Dashboard, Orçamentos, Propostas, Guias, Materiais) load correctly. Stock movement dialog working.

minor.issue: MaterialInput model doesn't include supplier_nif field - materials created via this endpoint won't have supplier_nif. Only materials created via import-invoice/apply have supplier_nif.

critical_code_review_comments: MaterialInput model in server.py (line 1578-1593) doesn't include supplier_nif field. Consider adding it for consistency with import-invoice/apply endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Test materials created during testing with TEST_ prefix were cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stock Invoice Import module fully tested. Key verified flows: (1) POST /api/materials/import-invoice/extract - returns 422 without file, 400 for invalid format (.txt, .doc), uses Gemini 2.5 Pro for OCR (not tested real OCR to save credits), (2) POST /api/materials/import-invoice/apply - returns 400 for empty lines, supports actions: create (creates material with supplier_nif + stock_movement type=entrada), update_stock_only (sums qty, preserves price), update_stock_and_price (sums qty + updates price + adds price_history with 'previous'), skip (ignores line), (3) Apply preserves existing supplier/supplier_nif, populates if empty, (4) Summary response includes counts: created, updated_stock, updated_price, skipped, stock_movements. Frontend: MateriaisPage has import-invoice-btn next to new-material-btn, clicking opens import-invoice-dialog with step=upload showing drag-and-drop area (invoice-upload-label), mentions Gemini 2.5 Pro and supported formats (PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP). Dialog has 3 steps: upload → extracting → review. Review step has bulk action buttons (bulk-accept-prices, bulk-reject-prices, bulk-skip-fuzzy) and per-line action dropdowns (import-action-{idx}). Apply button (apply-import-btn) submits decisions.
